capability.title: Site Footer
capability.description: Brand-colored site footer with the wordmark, social links, navigation column, opening hours, store contact information, a legal note, and an optional back-to-top link. Its column titles are h2 and store names are h3.
useWhen: A page needs the closing site shell with navigation, hours, contact details, and legal information
avoidWhen: The page needs an editorial closing section, testimonial, or location map instead of shell information
